wallet-service.count-permanent-notice: Igitigiri c'abarinzi ntigishobora guhindurwa hanyuma y'ugushiraho.
wallet-service.error-busy: Ishirahamwe ryawe riracaheraheza impinduka yawe iheruka.
wallet-service.error-generic: Hari ikitagenze neza mu gushiraho ishirahamwe ryawe.
wallet-service.error-invalid-fleet-managers: Umwe canke benshi mu bakira abarinzi ntibemewe.
wallet-service.error-maintenance-timeout: Abarinzi ntibashoboye kwumvikana kuri iyo mpinduka.
wallet-service.error-maintenance-too-large: Iyo mpinduka y'ishirahamwe ni nini cane ku buryo idashobora gushirwa mu ngiro.
wallet-service.error-selection: Ntitwashoboye kuronka abarinzi bahagije baboneka. Gerageza igitigiri gito.
wallet-service.fee-breakdown-eyebrow: Kuri buri 100,000 SATS abanywanyi bawe bacuruza
wallet-service.fee-breakdown-peerbadge-info: Igenzura rya Fedi ni isuzuma ribandanya ryemeza ko abarinzi bawe baguma ari abo kwizigirwa.
wallet-service.fee-finishing-setup: Turiko turaheraheza ugushiraho… Uzoshobora gushiraho amafaranga yawe mu kanya gato.
wallet-service.guardian-count-subtitle: Abarinzi barinda ishirahamwe ryawe. Uko abarinzi baba benshi, ni ko ugukomera kwiyongera.
wallet-service.insufficient-body: {{federation}} rifise {{available}}, ukeneye {{needed}}. Ongeramwo amafaranga kugira ubandanye.
wallet-service.insufficient-body-all-wallets: Amashirahamwe yawe afise {{available}} yose hamwe, ukeneye {{needed}}. Bitsa uvuye ku ngodomoni yo hanze, canke usubire inyuma uhitemwo abarinzi bake.
wallet-service.insufficient-title: Nta mafaranga ahagije yo gushiraho ishirahamwe ryawe
wallet-service.invite-subtitle: Uwusuzumye wese aronka ubutumire. Azokwinjira ari umunywanyi.
wallet-service.join-card-body: Ugushiraho abarinzi kurihwa mu ecash ibitswe mw'ishirahamwe. Kwinjira ni ubuntu.
wallet-service.join-failed-body: Subiramwo apu kugira usubire ugerageze, canke uvugane n'ikipe y'imfashanyo ya Fedi uvuge izina ry'ishirahamwe ryawe.
wallet-service.join-sheet-body: Ugushiraho abarinzi kurihwa mu ecash. Injira mw'ishirahamwe riri musi kugira ubandanye gushiraho.
wallet-service.join-sheet-empty-body: Ugushiraho abarinzi kurihwa mu ecash ivuye mw'ishirahamwe ryizigirwa ku kwishura ugushiraho. Nta co kwinjiramwo gihari ubu. Amashirahamwe mashasha azoboneka uko igihe kigenda.
wallet-service.join-sheet-error-body: Isuzuma ntiryarangiye, rero uru rutonde rushobora kuba rutari ubusa. Subira ugerageze mu kanya.
wallet-service.joined-top-up-next: Winjiye muri {{federation}}. Ryongeremwo amafaranga kugira wishure ugushiraho.
wallet-service.lightning-declined-note: Nta Mutanzi w'amafaranga yahiswemwo. Abanywanyi bawe ntibazoshobora kurungika canke kwakira biciye kuri Lightning.
wallet-service.lightning-manage-note: Umutanzi w'amafaranga wawe yagenzuwe aguma akora kandi ntashobora gukurwaho hano.
wallet-service.lightning-managed-detail: Bitunganywa kubwawe: nta co ukeneye gushiraho.
wallet-service.lightning-not-attached-note: Nta Mutanzi w'amafaranga arahuzwa. Abanywanyi bawe ntibashobora kurungika canke kwakira biciye kuri Lightning.
wallet-service.lightning-sheet-help: Umutanzi w'amafaranga w'ishirahamwe atuma abanywanyi bawe bashobora kurungika no kwakira biciye ku muhora wa Lightning.
wallet-service.lightning-stage-action-required-detail: Umutanzi w'amafaranga wawe akeneye ko umuyobozi wiwe agira ico akora imbere y'uko ibi bibandanya. Ntazosubira kugerageza wenyene.
wallet-service.lightning-stage-allocating-detail: Umutanzi w'amafaranga wawe ariko arashira ku ruhande amafaranga abanywanyi bawe bazokoresha mu kurungika no kwakira
wallet-service.lightning-stage-ready-detail: Abanywanyi bawe ubu barashobora kurungika no kwakira biciye kuri Lightning
wallet-service.lightning-stage-requested-detail: Turiko turasaba Umutanzi w'amafaranga wahisemwo gateway ya Lightning
wallet-service.lightning-stage-verifying-detail: Umutanzi w'amafaranga wawe avuga ko gateway yubatswe. Ubu abarinzi bawe bariko baremeranya ko ikora imbere y'uko tuvuga ko yiteguye. Iyi ni yo ntambwe ndende kuruta izindi.
wallet-service.lightning-takes-a-while: Ibi bisanzwe bifata nk'amasaha 2. Ugushiraho kurabandanya inyuma, rero urashobora kuva kuri iyi mugaragaza ukagaruka.
wallet-service.not-enough-body: Ntitwashoboye gukoranya umurwi w'abarinzi {{requested}} bagenzuwe ubu. Gerageza umurwi w'abarinzi muto, canke usubire ugerageze hanyuma.
wallet-service.not-enough-body-minimum: Ntitwashoboye gukoranya umurwi w'abarinzi {{requested}} bagenzuwe ubu. Yewe, subira ugerageze hanyuma.
wallet-service.payer-lookup-failed-body: Ntitwashoboye kuraba ingodomoni zawe zishobora kwishura ugushiraho. Igiciro co gushiraho kiri musi nticahindutse: garuka hanyuma.
wallet-service.payment-failed-body: Ingodomoni yawe ikeneye kwishura igiciro co gushiraho n'amafaranga y'umuhora wayo, rero amafaranga ari hejuru si yo yose hamwe. Ongeramwo amafaranga hanyuma usubire ugerageze.
wallet-service.progress-notice: Ugushiraho kurabandanya inyuma. Urashobora kuvaho ukagaruka igihe cose: tuzobandanya tubikora.
wallet-service.quote-lost-guardians: Igiciro cawe cataye igihe kandi umurwi w'abakira abarinzi {{requested}} ntiwashoboye gusubira gukoranywa. Hitamwo umurwi w'abarinzi muto, canke usubire ugerageze: abakira bashasha baraboneka uko igihe kigenda.
wallet-service.reconnecting: Turiko turasubira guhuza n'abarinzi bawe. Ugushiraho kuracabandanya.
wallet-service.recovery-failed-body: Nta kintu kiri kuri iki gikoresho gishobora kubisubiramwo. Vugana n'ikipe y'imfashanyo ya Fedi uvuge izina ry'ishirahamwe ryawe.
wallet-service.recovery-stage-found-detail: Ububiko bw'ishirahamwe ryawe bwabonetse kuri relays
wallet-service.recovery-stage-rejoining-detail: Turiko turasubira guhuza iki gikoresho n'ishirahamwe ryawe
wallet-service.recovery-stage-restoringBalance-detail: Turiko turagaruza ecash yawe ivuye mw'ishirahamwe. Iyi ni yo ntambwe ndende kuruta izindi.
wallet-service.recovery-stage-verifying-detail: Turiko turagereranya ububiko n'abarinzi bafise intebe zawe
wallet-service.recovery-taking-longer: Ibi biriko biratwara igihe kirenze ico twari twiteze. Urashobora kuvaho ukagaruka: kugaruza kurabandanya inyuma.
wallet-service.replace-body: Umwe mu bakira abarinzi wahisemwo ntakiboneka. Suzuma uwumusubirira kugira ubandanye gushiraho.
wallet-service.replace-cause-body: Amafaranga wamurihiye yagarujwe kandi abandi barinzi bawe baguma bemejwe. Emeza uwumusubirira kugira uheraheze ugushiraho.
wallet-service.replace-cost-note: Birihira intebe zisubirira gusa. Ivyo wishuye imbere ntivyahindutse.
wallet-service.replace-not-found: Twabonye abarinzi basubirira {{selected}} muri {{requested}}. Turiko turongereza ubushobozi bw'abarinzi, kandi abarinzi wamaze kuronka baragumaho mu gihe turindiriye.
wallet-service.resilience-help: Umubare w'abarinzi bashobora kuva ku murongo imbere y'uko ishirahamwe ryawe rihagarika gukora.
wallet-service.restart-body: Niba umaze iminota 15 gushika kuri 20 urindiriye kandi ugushiraho kukaba kutararangira, vyoshobora kuba vyiza kugerageza gusubira gutangura. Gusubira gutangura bisaba abarinzi bawe gusubira gutangura iyi ntambwe. Ukwishura kwawe n'abarinzi bawe ntibihinduka.
wallet-service.restart-hint: Biriko biratwara igihe kirenze ico twari twiteze?
wallet-service.revenue-help: Uko abarinzi baba bake, ni ko umugabane wawe w'amafaranga ya serivisi uba munini.
wallet-service.set-changed-body: Umurinzi yabuze, maze arasubirirwa. Igiciro co gushiraho carahindutse. Suzuma kandi wemeze imbere yo kwishura.
wallet-service.settings-description-help: Abanywanyi babona ubu butumwa igihe binjira no mu nsobanuro z'ingodomoni.
wallet-service.settings-fee-help: Ijanisha ishirahamwe ryawe rikusanya kuri buri gikorwa c'ubucuruzi. Urashobora kubihindura hanyuma.
wallet-service.settings-fee-members-note: Abanywanyi berekwa igipimo imbere y'uko binjira.
wallet-service.settings-icon-help: Abanywanyi babona aka gashusho iruhande y'ishirahamwe ryawe. Shiramwo link y'ishusho rusangi.
wallet-service.settings-icon-invalid: Injiza aderesi ya internet itangurwa na http:// canke https://
wallet-service.settings-icon-not-public: Ishusho itegerezwa kuba kuri aderesi rusangi ya internet abanywanyi bashobora gushikako
wallet-service.settings-name-help: Abanywanyi babona iri zina igihe binjira no ku rutonde rw'ingodomoni zabo.
wallet-service.settings-stable-balance-detail: Reka abanywanyi bagumane amafaranga asigaye ahamye ku USD. Biraboneka ku busabe.
wallet-service.settings-stable-balance-note: Ibi bifungura ikiganiro n'ikipe ya Fedi, ishobora kubishoboza mw'ishirahamwe ryawe.
wallet-service.settings-stable-balance-sheet-help: Amafaranga asigaye arakwiye atuma abanywanyi bawe bagumana amafaranga asigaye ahamye ku USD mw'ishirahamwe ryawe. Biratangwa ku busabe kugira tubanze turabe ko bibereye imbere yo kubishoboza.
wallet-service.settings-terms-help: Abanywanyi babona aya masezerano imbere y'uko binjira.
wallet-service.settings-terms-link-own-help: Shiramwo link rusangi y'amasezerano yawe. Abanywanyi bayibona imbere y'uko binjira.
wallet-service.settings-terms-not-public: Amasezerano ategerezwa kuba kuri aderesi rusangi ya internet abanywanyi bashobora gushikako
wallet-service.settings-terms-ready-made-detail: Amasezerano rusangi ari kuri Fedi. Nta nsobanuro zihariye ku ishirahamwe ryawe.
wallet-service.settings-terms-sheet-help: Si ngombwa. Yongeremwo ubu canke ubireke ugaruke hanyuma.
wallet-service.settings-withdraw-detail: Imurira ayasigaye yawe mu ngodomoni yawe
wallet-service.stage-created-detail: Turiko turashira ishirahamwe ryawe ku murongo
wallet-service.stage-ecash-sent-detail: Turiko turatanga inoti zivuye mw'ishirahamwe ryawe ryizigirwa tukazirungikira abarinzi bawe
wallet-service.stage-guardians-confirmed-detail: Buri murinzi agenzura kandi agasubira gutanga ecash
wallet-service.topup-invoice-expired: Iyo fagitire yataye igihe. Kora iyindi kugira wongeremwo amafaranga.
wallet-service.topup-join-body: Ukeneye kwinjira muri {{federation}} imbere y'uko rishobora kwishura ugushiraho.
wallet-service.topup-leaves-short: Ibi bituma habura {{amount}} ku giciro co gushiraho.
wallet-service.topup-not-received: Ntivyarashika. Ukwishura gushobora gufata iminota mikeyi kugira kwemezwe.
wallet-service.topup-source-body: Ayimure uvuye mu rindi shirahamwe ako kanya, canke ubitse uvuye ku ngodomoni yo hanze.
wallet-service.topup-source-external-detail: Suzuma canke usangize fagitire ya Lightning
wallet-service.topup-source-internal-eyebrow: Bivuye mu rindi shirahamwe · ako kanya
wallet-service.topup-still-short: Haracabura {{amount}}. Subira wongeremwo amafaranga kugira ubandanye.
wallet-service.topup-to-fixed: Aho amafaranga aja ntihahinduka: iri ni ryo shirahamwe ririha ugushiraho.
wallet-service.tour-balance-body: Amafaranga ya serivisi abanywanyi bawe bakurishe, arindiriye kwakirwa. Aguma ahishwe gushika ufyonze ku jisho, rero urashobora kwugurura apu aho ari ho hose.
wallet-service.tour-settings-body: Hindura izina ry'ishirahamwe ryawe, uhindure agashusho karyo, uhindure amafaranga ya serivisi, uhitemwo Umutanzi w'amafaranga canke wongeremwo amasezerano ya serivisi yawe.
wallet-service.tour-withdraw-body: Imurira amafaranga ari hejuru mu ngodomoni yawe, igihe cose ushaka. Abanywanyi bawe nta co bibakoraho: bimura gusa amafaranga yawe bwite.
wallet-service.tour-withdraw-title: Akira amafaranga yawe igihe cose ushaka
wallet-service.verification-help: Umurinzi wese muri uyu murwi afise ikimenyetso c'igenzura rya Fedi cemewe, catanzwe n'urwego rwizigirwa.
